limitations: The guidance does not prove exactly-once transport; the reproduction therefore separates at-least-once replay from an idempotent receiver effect.
retrieval_method: Python 3 standard-library HTTPS GET with a descriptive research user agent; redirect target recorded.

source.admitted_claim: The transactional outbox pattern stores the business object and event in the same transaction, then a separate process publishes the event; consumers should be idempotent because duplicate delivery can occur.
source.title: Transactional outbox pattern - AWS Prescriptive Guidance
